clue.text: Scientifically assessing age of vehicle (French, good) before taking out

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
bon is the French word for good
taking someone out is dating them

explanation.surface: Someone examines how old a French car is before driving it off.
explanation.walkthrough: The bracket '(French, good)' looks like a note on the car's make but gives BON; 'before' just sets CAR BON ahead of DATING.
explanation.definitionFit: Radiocarbon measurement is the standard laboratory method for estimating how old organic material is.

clue.text: A friend beginning to make a word out of initials

parts.note: a crony is a close friend

indicators.note: the beginning of the word make is its opening letter, used here alone

explanation.surface: A pal starts making a word from people's initials.
explanation.definitionFit: NATO or laser are examples: a term formed from the opening letters of a phrase.

clue.text: Sweeping up with bishop, in a hurry

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
rushing means going in a hurry

explanation.surface: A bishop hurriedly sweeps up the church floor.
explanation.definitionFit: To sweep up dust with a broom is to brush it away.

clue.text: Born and died in poverty

parts.note: née, used before a maiden name, means born
d is the standard abbreviation for died in genealogies

explanation.surface: An obituary line: someone was born and died poor.
explanation.definitionFit: Want or destitution is called need, as in families in need.

clue.text: Girl protected by going around in two minds

indicators.note: the girl's name sits sheltered inside the surrounding word, a container signal

parts.note: ambient describes what surrounds or goes around something
Val is a girl's name, short for Valerie

explanation.surface: A girl is guarded by someone circling her, and she cannot decide.
explanation.definitionFit: Being undecided between two attitudes is the meaning of the adjective, an idiomatic synonym.

clue.text: Expose oneself to vicious dog at home first

indicators.note: first tells us the home word comes ahead of the dog word in the answer

parts.note: being in means being at home
a cur is a snappish, worthless dog

explanation.surface: Someone risks a nasty dog by staying home.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring a cost or danger on yourself, as in incurring a penalty, is to lay yourself open to it.

clue.text: Bird is -blimey!-a week behind

indicators.note: behind places the a-week pieces after the exclamation in the answer

parts.note: blimey and gosh are both exclamations of surprise

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher exclaims that a sighting came a week late.
explanation.definitionFit: A large hawk of woodland, used in falconry, is a type of bird of prey.

clue.text: Reputation has precedence over rank: this is a procedural rule

indicators.note: in a down clue the first word stands above and before the second, so it leads

parts.note: standing is one's reputation or status
order is a rank or class

explanation.surface: In a committee, status outranks seniority as a rule of procedure.
explanation.definitionFit: Parliaments and councils run under permanent written regulations governing their business.

clue.text: Pele's goal is to mix with caveman

indicators.note: mix tells us to stir these letters into a new order

parts.note: here the S of the possessive counts as a letter of the fodder

explanation.surface: The great Brazilian footballer's aim is to socialise with a prehistoric man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mix' rearranges all of PELES GOAL IS TO; the possessive S of 'Pele's' is needed as a letter. 'caveman' is a playful term for a cave explorer.
explanation.definitionFit: A scientist who explores and studies caves can be called a caveman with a smile.

clue.text: Rich cake containing half curd put on rack

indicators.note: containing means the cake wraps round the curd letters

parts.note: a torte is a rich layered cake

indicators.note: half of the four-letter word curd is taken from its middle

explanation.surface: A rich cake with some curd in it is set on a cooling rack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half' takes UR, the central two letters of CURD, which 'containing' puts inside TORTE.
explanation.definitionFit: The rack was a medieval instrument for torment, so to be put on it is to be tormented.

clue.text: Supports defensive players appearing for trial

parts.note: backs are defenders in football or rugby
a defendant is said to be up before the court

explanation.surface: Defenders are called into court.
explanation.definitionFit: To give support or confirmation to someone is a common phrasal verb sense.

clue.text: Several places behind leader going into St Martin-in-the-Fields

indicators.note: the answer is found going into the run of letters in the church's name

explanation.surface: A runner falls back before heading into a famous London church.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'MartiN-IN-THe'. St Martin-in-the-Fields is a church on Trafalgar Square in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Eighth after the winner, i.e. a placing well down the order.

clue.text: Higher bid for remaining ring

parts.note: food left over is remaining
to ring someone is to call them on the phone

explanation.surface: An auction-goer phones to bid again on an unsold lot.
explanation.definitionFit: In bridge, bidding above the opponent's last bid is this action.

clue.text: This month let man off regular payment

parts.note: inst., short for instant, means of the current month in old business letters

indicators.note: off here means out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: This month someone releases a man from his regular payments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges LET MAN to ALMENT after INST.
explanation.definitionFit: A loan or purchase is often repaid in one of a series of fixed portions.

clue.text: Very soon I add ten ml in my recipe

indicators.note: a recipe is a mixing formula, so the letters are combined anew

explanation.surface: A cook adds ten millilitres of something in their recipe right away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recipe' rearranges TEN ML IN MY, which follows I.
explanation.definitionFit: Something happening at any moment now is about to occur.

clue.text: Key resort after September 1st is this island

indicators.note: after places the shuffled key letters behind the September letter
the 1st of September is read as the opening letter of the word
re-sort means sort again, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Holiday-makers head to a key resort island at the start of autumn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' (re-sort) rearranges KEY to KYE, placed 'after' S. SKYE is an island in the Scottish Hebrides.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hebridean isle off Scotland's west coast is named here.

clue.text: Is driving group accepting call from this woman?

indicators.note: accepting means the motoring letters take the call inside

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, a British motoring organisation
to bell someone is British slang for phoning them

explanation.surface: A motoring organisation answers a call from a particular woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's given name, borne by the Spanish queen who backed Columbus.

clue.text: Proceed: note the blood

parts.note: to proceed is to go
re is the second note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A command to proceed, then a warning about blood.
explanation.definitionFit: Spilt clotted blood from a wound is called gore.

clue.text: Tell story of king meeting English nobleman

parts.note: R, for rex, abbreviates king
a count is a European nobleman

explanation.surface: A tale of a monarch meeting an English aristocrat.
explanation.definitionFit: To narrate events in sequence is to relate or tell them.

clue.text: Stop putting cash box behind exhibition areas

indicators.note: behind places the cash box word after the exhibition word

parts.note: stands are the display areas at a trade show
a till is a shop's cash drawer

explanation.surface: Organisers halt proceedings by putting a cashier's box at the back of the show stands.
explanation.definitionFit: A halt in which all movement ceases is a complete stop.

clue.text: First sign, in short

explanation.surface: A clipped note about the opening mark.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means occurring at the start; as a verb it means to sign with abbreviated letters of one's name.

clue.text: Gather round men of intelligence on ethnic basis

indicators.note: round means the gathering word encloses the agency letters

parts.note: to rally is to gather together
the CIA is the US Central Intelligence Agency

explanation.surface: People gather round spies for reasons of race.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb describes acting according to race or ethnic origin.

clue.text: Saw publicity, period

parts.note: an ad is a piece of publicity
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Someone saw an advert for a stretch of time.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw in the noun sense is an old saying or proverb.

clue.text: Fetch group

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Fetch group' (5): 'Fetch' defines BRING and 'group' gives RING, but nothing in the clue as held supplies the B; a word (e.g. for book or bishop) appears lost in OCR and no reprint was found.

clue.text: Bill and yours truly are top

parts.note: ac is short for account, a bill
yours truly is a way of referring to oneself, me

explanation.surface: Bill and I declare ourselves the best.
explanation.definitionFit: The peak or highest point of achievement is the summit.

clue.text: Follow example of Antipodean creature unable to fly recently

parts.note: the emu is a flightless Australian bird
lately or late means recently

explanation.surface: An Australian bird has only lately become grounded.
explanation.definitionFit: To copy someone admired is to imitate or follow them.

clue.text: Cocktail dictionary

explanation.definitionFit: A Tom ____ is a gin-based mixed drink, and the publisher HarperCollins issues a well-known reference wordbook of that name.

clue.text: Very French battle involved the French item of portable furniture

parts.note: très is the French for very

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: le is the French masculine definite article

explanation.surface: A very French battle is fought over a piece of camp furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' rearranges BATTLE to TLETAB, between TRES and LE.
explanation.definitionFit: A board on folding supports, set up for fêtes or decorating, is a temporary table.
